prompt.project_info: Create a casual 2x2 smartphone-style Pilates workout collage of an approved adult blonde woman in a simple studio or gym corner.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult blonde woman with elegant natural features and a calm focused expression, wearing the same white sports bra and grey fitted shorts in every frame. Keep realistic skin texture and an unposed workout-break presence.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 grid on a 4:5 canvas showing standing roll-down, Pilates hundred, side leg lift, and seated spine or mermaid stretch. Use imperfect handheld framing, mild blur, uneven exposure, and ordinary mats with neutral walls.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Ambient indoor light only, casual real-workout atmosphere, natural color and slight digital noise rather than polished studio lighting.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 collage canvas, four smartphone-photo panels, low-resolution handheld feel, mild wide-angle distortion, slight motion blur, visible grain, imperfect focus and framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a casual 2x2 grid collage on a 4:5 canvas using smartphone-style photos of an approved adult blonde woman doing Pilates in a simple studio or gym corner. Keep the same white sports bra and grey fitted shorts across all four panels, with realistic skin and a calm focused expression. Show standing roll-down, Pilates hundred, side leg lift, and seated spine or mermaid stretch. Use ambient indoor light, neutral walls, basic mats, low-resolution handheld character, mild blur, uneven exposure, slight wide-angle distortion, digital noise, and imperfect framing.
